verdict.rationale: Greptile documents a `greptile.json` file at the repo root. It is read from the PR's source branch and overrides dashboard settings, and it controls review behavior, PR filters, file patterns, custom context, custom rules and repo-specific standards. Separate docs cover ignoring files and scoping review settings, rules and context to the directories each team owns. Missing for 10: named or switchable review profiles are not evidenced (only a 1–3 strictness setting); per-directory scoping is not explicitly tied to greptile.json; there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the config file.
